description: main has no required status checks, so platformAutomerge stays false and Renovate waits for PR checks before merging.
This repository writes type-prefixed commit subjects itself, so Renovate follows the same convention.
Claude Code releases most days, so updates are checked daily, and its non-major updates go with the routine group like any other dependency.
The gitleaks release that scripts/gitleaks.ts pins is updated on its own branch, since CI fails until someone runs `bun run gitleaks` there.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major dependency updates after checks pass.
